title: Prove unbounded two-role right-vector cost over F2[t] (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

Scoped proof answering Open next question 1 of #4276 negatively. In the two-role right-vector alphabet over F2[t], with binary right vectors and free GL2(F2) maps anywhere:

```text
U = [[1,t],[0,1]], L = [[1,0],[t,1]]
M = (UL)^2 = [[1+t^2+t^4,t^3],[t^3,1+t^2]]
cost(M) = 4
cost((UL)^k) = 2k for every k >= 1; delta((UL)^k) = 2
```

Every invertible target has a unique reduced expression in constant-free directional transvections followed by one binary free map. Its paid cost equals reduced length. Hence reachable two-role targets have unbounded cost even over a commutative coefficient algebra. F2[t] is not semilocal, so the result is outside #4749's three-factor hypothesis. No new kappa or selected-frontier change.

Produced by Nick Petalas. Wentao Li #4099/#2513 supplies the alphabet and column bound; Nick Petalas #4243/#4276 supplies the free-map normal form, one-factor criterion and explicit open question. ToikY #4334 and Nick Petalas #4601/#4749 supply the field-product, local-product and semilocal boundaries. Hirosi Nagao's 1959 polynomial-matrix structure and degree method retain their classical credit. The restricted-alphabet cost consequence and self-contained binary proof are the contribution here; no new group-theoretic normal-form theorem is claimed.

## Evidence

- Before: #4276 asks whether every reachable two-role target over every algebra has cost at most three. #4749 proves the bound under a semilocal hypothesis.
- After: PROOF.md gives an explicit invertible cost-four target, a quantified lower bound permitting arbitrary polynomial coefficients and all free binary maps, and the direct unbounded-cost corollary.
- The finite verifier enumerates all 1,536 invertible polynomial matrices with maximum entry degree at most four. Exact costs zero through four have histogram `[6,270,612,504,144]`. All 1,008 reduced degree-four expressions of length at most three, including every free endpoint, miss M. The written degree proof justifies this bounded domain for the finite exclusion; it supplies the unbounded statement separately.
- A separate literal alphabet check covers 3,072 left-vector/right-direction parameter tuples and finds 96 invertible tuples, including repeated identities. Every invertible tuple passes constant splitting and all six free conjugations. Seven controls detect changes to the degree assumptions, coefficients, word and endpoint.
- Both registered warning-strict ordinary/optimized commands passed locally, timed at 0.04 seconds each. The package runner passed. In-memory compilation passed; optional external Python analyzers were unavailable. Every function is below 60 lines and every loop has the documented finite bound. The generated receipt hashes all six package files.
- Committed-byte/source-history preflight passed for seven package/input files at `d0158a552352c09608295a7ec47dd31327b360ae`. Official committed export creation and integrity check passed. An optimized Git-free export replay produced the same marker and complete generated receipt.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

The infinite claim is a written scoped proof, with finite corroboration. Two roles, base field F2, coefficient algebra F2[t], binary free maps and no scratch are essential to the stated classification. Singular targets, other base fields and multivariate algebras are not classified. Native preparation, conversion, routing, control, precision, restoration, stock and complete supplier costs remain unknown. No native supplier, complete multiplication theorem, independent human acceptance or formal proof-kernel review is supplied. Lean, Docker and the selected operator replay were not run; they are outside the stated result. No registered package check remains unrun locally.

## Open next questions

- Classify costs over F2[s,t], starting with one named reachable word. General reachability and a multivariate normal form are separate obligations.
- Identify one literal native producer/consumer coefficient algebra, then price left-coefficient preparation and the complete physical bill before using the abstract factor count in a supplier.

## Related open work

- #4749, head `29e4d3a25225a219f97c3a2815ed3a5a8fd9b891`, proves a three-factor bound for invertible semilocal targets. F2[t] lies outside that hypothesis. Our six constant binary free targets agree numerically with the six cost-zero targets in its reported binary dual-number compatibility control; no other target census overlaps.
- #4745, head `3edea13af13b755932852e9306a714b317630dda`, classifies radical targets over split square-zero local algebras. Its singular radical endpoints are disjoint from our invertible polynomial endpoints; no shared target count is claimed.

Merged #4601/#4613 concern invertible local algebras and finite controls. Their local target domains are disjoint from the polynomial domain here. Main/merged searches used the alphabet, polynomial algebra, explicit matrix, unbounded cost and Nagao terms. The overlap helper reported 521 open PR bodies and 3,679 Discussion records with complete pagination at refresh. Its local-note coverage is sparse, and arbitrary diffs and unpublished work are not exhaustively covered. Live open PRs and recent handoff claims were rechecked immediately before committing.

- #4766, head `5af823b1a14b2517235925145e36581bfdfcad41`, counts radical targets over finite split square-zero algebras. Its zero-residue singular endpoints are disjoint from our invertible polynomial endpoints. No cost or census number overlaps.
- #4770, head `39ef149ba3ea8adbda18478ea227d3d0826475ab`, counts lifts of rank-one residues over finite-dimensional local algebras. Those singular targets and coefficient algebras are outside the present invertible F2[t] domain. No target-cost or census number overlaps.

#4761 concerns chain retiming, #4767 and #4769 concern full-guard header probabilities, and #4771 concerns scalar-pivot Schur dimensions. They study different objects and quantities. No conflicting overlapping number was found. The earlier six-constant-target compatibility agreement with #4749 remains recorded above.
